backend/main.mo: Main canister actor defining authorization mixin and all core domain types for members, finances, programs, groups, attendance, committees, and literature.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module defining old/new actor schemas and a run function to transform stored data to include books and sentences.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, related files, components, and test IDs with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of all major frontend files including pages, hooks, components, and utilities.
frontend/.gitignore: Git ignore rules for frontend dependencies, builds, environment files, IDE artifacts, OS files, and Android build outputs.
frontend/android/app/build.gradle: Android app module Gradle config defining SDK versions, packaging rules, dependencies, and Google services integration.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/drawab: Vector drawable defining the solid green background for the app launcher icon.
Vector drawable defining the foreground icon graphics with circular shapes.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/mipmap: Round adaptive launcher icon XML referencing the same background and foreground assets.
Adaptive launcher icon XML referencing background and foreground drawables.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/values: Android resource file defining primary, dark, and accent color values.
Android styles configuration defining the app theme, status bar behavior, and no-action-bar variants.
frontend/android/build.gradle: Top-level Android Gradle config setting plugin versions, repositories, and clean task.
frontend/android/gradle.properties: Configures Gradle performance, AndroidX settings, Kotlin incremental builds, and R8 shrinking.
frontend/BUILD_ANDROID.md: Documentation explaining prerequisites and steps for building the Android APK using Capacitor and Android Studio.
frontend/capacitor.config.ts: Defines Capacitor app settings, Android build options, and web directory configuration.
frontend/index.css: Sets Tailwind base styles and extensive CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point defining meta tags, icons, manifest, and loading the main React script.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest specifying app name, colors, icons, orientation, and startup behavior.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app routing and authentication gates handling identity, profile loading, and startup errors.
frontend/src/components/bookReader/Sente: Controls text‑to‑speech playback with options for speed, pitch, autoplay, and play/stop actions.
Displays and edits section committee roles using dialogs and member selection.
frontend/src/components/financial/Financ: Dialog showing detailed financial report fields, grouping deposits and expenses and formatting amounts, with dynamic sections for vows and other income.
frontend/src/components/GeneratedAssetsP: Hidden component that ensures generated static assets are bundled in Android builds.
frontend/src/components/groups/GroupFina: Dialog for listing, creating, editing, and deleting group financial reports with form handling and currency formatting.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: App-wide layout providing header, navigation, mobile menu, logout handling, and section-aware UI via context.
frontend/src/components/StartupErrorScre: UI screen showing startup errors with details and a retry option.
frontend/src/components/SyncStatus.tsx: Shows last sync time and activity indicator based on ongoing queries or mutations.
frontend/src/contexts/SectionContext.tsx: Context storing and updating the user’s current section, loading it from profile and exposing label helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and caching a backend actor based on identity, invalidating dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider managing Internet Identity login, stored identities, login state, and logout behavior.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for user profiles, books, and sentences using a backend actor with caching and mutation utilities.
frontend/src/hooks/useSafeActor.ts: Initializes and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity with retry and access control setup.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechSynthesis.ts: Implements speech synthesis controls including speaking, stopping, and adjustable rate and pitch.
frontend/src/hooks/useStartupRetry.ts: Offers a retry helper that reinitializes the actor and refetches the current user profile on startup errors.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and OKLCH color themes for light, dark, and reading modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AttendancePage.tsx: Displays and edits attendance records with creation, update, deletion, and consecutive absence detection.
frontend/src/pages/BookEditorPage.tsx: Provides a UI for editing a book’s metadata and managing its sentences with CRUD operations.
frontend/src/pages/BookLibraryPage.tsx: Displays the book library, listing books, creating new ones via a dialog, and allowing deletion with confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/BookReaderPage.tsx: Loads a book and provides sentence-by-sentence text-to-speech reading with autoplay and navigation back to the library.
Manages financial reports including listing, creating, editing, viewing details, and computing income and expenses.
frontend/src/pages/GroupsPage.tsx: Handles CRUD operations for groups, assigning officers and members, and accessing group financial reports.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Presents an Internet Identity login screen with the app logo and a login button.
frontend/src/pages/MembersPage.tsx: Manages member records with search, create/edit dialogs, and deletion within the current section.
frontend/src/pages/ProgramsPage.tsx: UI page for listing, creating, editing, and deleting programs tied to the current section, with member lookup and dialog-based form handling.
frontend/src/pages/SectionSelectPage.tsx: Page for selecting a section and optionally entering a user name during initial setup, saving the profile via backend hooks.
frontend/src/utils/attendanceConsecutive: Utility that detects members with three or more consecutive absences by scanning sorted attendance records.
frontend/src/utils/memberAge.ts: Provides helpers to compute age from a date string and format it safely, returning placeholders for invalid data.
frontend/src/utils/startupDiagnostics.ts: Utility functions for normalizing, sanitizing, summarizing, and logging errors during app startup.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugin setup for the frontend.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s current state, required images, and a list of existing implemented features for a book‑based reading app with text‑to‑speech and content editing. Used as a snapshot for planning further development.
